title: Kamal Deployment Configuration
markdownDescription:
Configuration for Kamal, a deployment tool that enables zero-downtime deploys, rolling restarts, and container management on any server with Docker. Originally built for Rails apps but works with any containerized web application.

[Kamal Documentation](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/)

registry.markdownDescription:
Docker registry configuration for pushing and pulling images.

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/docker-registry/)

server.markdownDescription:
The registry server URL. Defaults to Docker Hub if not specified.

If the server starts with `localhost`, Kamal will start a local Docker registry on that port and push the app image to it.

**Example:**
```yaml
registry:
  server: ghcr.io
```

username.markdownDescription:
⚠️ Registry username for authentication. Can be a string, or an array with a single secret name to look up. Required unless the registry server is `localhost`.

**Example:**
```yaml
registry:
  username: myuser
```

password.markdownDescription:
⚠️ Registry password for authentication. Can be a string, or an array with a single secret name to look up. Required unless the registry server is `localhost`.

**Security:** Always use environment variables or the secrets file for passwords.

**Example:**
```yaml
registry:
  password:
    - KAMAL_REGISTRY_PASSWORD
```

env.markdownDescription:
Environment variables configuration for containers. Either a simple hash of clear values, or a hash with `clear`, `secret` and `tags` keys.

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/environment-variables/)

clear.markdownDescription:
Environment variables that are stored in plain text (not encrypted).

**Example:**
```yaml
env:
  clear:
    RAILS_ENV: production
    LOG_LEVEL: info
```

secret.markdownDescription:
⚠️ List of environment variable names that should be loaded from the secrets file. These are sensitive values like API keys and passwords.

Use `ENV_NAME:SECRET_NAME` to alias a secret to a different environment variable name.

**Example:**
```yaml
env:
  secret:
    - DATABASE_URL
    - SECRET_KEY_BASE
```

tags.markdownDescription:
Environment variables specific to server tags, allowing different values per server group. Only allowed in the root `env`.

**Example:**
```yaml
env:
  tags:
    production:
      clear:
        RAILS_ENV: production
```

clear.markdownDescription: Plain text environment variables for this tag.

secret.markdownDescription: Secret environment variable names for this tag.

proxy.markdownDescription:
Configuration for kamal-proxy, which provides zero-downtime deployments by running on ports 80 and 443 and forwarding requests to application containers.

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/proxy/)

host.markdownDescription:
The hostname that will be used to serve the app. The proxy will only route requests to this host to your app. Multiple hosts can be given as a comma-separated string.

If no hosts are set, then all requests will be forwarded, except for matching requests for other apps deployed on that server that do have a host set.

Specify one of `host` or `hosts`.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  host: foo.example.com
```

hosts.markdownDescription:
Multiple hostnames that will be used to serve the app.

Specify one of `host` or `hosts`.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  hosts:
    - foo.example.com
    - bar.example.com
```

app_port.markdownDescription:
The port the application container is exposed on.

**Default:** `80`

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  app_port: 3000
```

anyOf.markdownDescription: Use a custom SSL certificate loaded from secrets instead of Let's Encrypt. Both keys must be set.

certificate_pem.markdownDescription: ⚠️ Name of the secret containing the certificate in PEM format.

private_key_pem.markdownDescription: ⚠️ Name of the secret containing the private key in PEM format.

ssl.markdownDescription:
Enable automatic HTTPS via Let's Encrypt. Requires deploying to one server with the host option set and port 443 open.

Alternatively, pass a hash mapping `certificate_pem` and `private_key_pem` to secret names to use a custom SSL certificate.

**Default:** `false`

**Note:** When enabled, kamal-proxy will stop forwarding headers unless you explicitly set `forward_headers: true`.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  ssl: true
```

```yaml
proxy:
  ssl:
    certificate_pem: CERTIFICATE_PEM
    private_key_pem: PRIVATE_KEY_PEM
```

ssl_redirect.markdownDescription:
Whether to redirect all HTTP requests to HTTPS when SSL is enabled. Set to `false` to pass HTTP traffic through to your application.

**Default:** `true`

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  ssl_redirect: false
```

forward_headers.markdownDescription:
Whether to forward the `X-Forwarded-For` and `X-Forwarded-Proto` headers. Set to `true` if behind a trusted proxy.

**Default:** `false` when SSL is enabled, `true` otherwise.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  forward_headers: true
```

response_timeout.markdownDescription:
How long to wait for requests to complete before timing out, in seconds.

**Default:** `30`

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  response_timeout: 10
```

healthcheck.markdownDescription:
Configure healthcheck behavior during deployments. The proxy will hit the healthcheck endpoint once per interval until the app is up.

**Defaults:** path `/up`, interval `1` second, timeout `5` seconds

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  healthcheck:
    interval: 3
    path: /health
    timeout: 3
```

interval.markdownDescription:
Seconds between healthcheck attempts during deployment.

**Default:** `1`

path.markdownDescription:
The HTTP path to check for application readiness.

**Default:** `/up`

timeout.markdownDescription:
Timeout in seconds for each healthcheck request.

**Default:** `5`

buffering.markdownDescription:
Configure request and response body buffering in the proxy.

**Defaults:** Enabled with 1GB max request body, unlimited response size, 1MB memory buffer.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  buffering:
    requests: true
    max_request_body: 40000000
    memory: 2000000
```

max_request_body.markdownDescription:
Maximum request body size to buffer, in bytes. Set to 0 for unlimited.

**Default:** `1000000000` (1GB)

max_response_body.markdownDescription:
Maximum response body size to buffer, in bytes. Set to 0 for unlimited.

**Default:** `0` (unlimited)

memory.markdownDescription:
Memory limit for buffering in bytes. Content larger than this is written to disk.

**Default:** `1000000` (1MB)

logging.markdownDescription:
Configure request logging for the proxy.

**Default:** Logs `Cache-Control`, `Last-Modified`, and `User-Agent` request headers.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  logging:
    request_headers:
      - Cache-Control
      - X-Forwarded-Proto
```

request_headers.markdownDescription: List of request header names to log.

response_headers.markdownDescription: List of response header names to log.

path_prefix.markdownDescription:
Mount the app under a path prefix for path-based routing. Multiple prefixes can be given as a comma-separated string.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  path_prefix: "/api,/oauth_callback"
```

path_prefixes.markdownDescription:
Mount the app under multiple path prefixes for path-based routing.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  path_prefixes:
    - "/api"
    - "/oauth_callback"
```

strip_path_prefix.markdownDescription:
Whether to strip the path prefix from the request before forwarding it upstream. Set to `false` to forward the request with the original path.

**Default:** `true`

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  strip_path_prefix: false
```

run.markdownDescription:
Options used when booting the kamal-proxy container. All roles and accessories on the same host must use identical run configuration.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  run:
    http_port: 8080
    https_port: 8443
    version: v0.9.2
```

publish.markdownDescription:
Publish ports to the host. When `false`, `http_port`, `https_port` and `bind_ips` cannot be set.

**Default:** `true`

bind_ips.markdownDescription:
List of IP addresses to bind to when publishing ports.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  run:
    bind_ips:
      - 0.0.0.0
```

registry.markdownDescription:
Container registry for the kamal-proxy image.

**Default:** Docker Hub

repository.markdownDescription:
Container repository for the kamal-proxy image.

**Default:** `basecamp/kamal-proxy`

version.markdownDescription:
Version tag of the kamal-proxy image to use.

**Default:** `v0.9.2`

options.markdownDescription:
Additional options to pass to `docker run`.

**Example:**
```yaml
proxy:
  run:
    options:
      memory: 512m
      cpus: 0.5
```

logging.markdownDescription:
Docker logging driver configuration. Can be specified at root level or per role.

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/logging/)

driver.markdownDescription:
The Docker logging driver to use. Passed to Docker via `--log-driver`.

**Common drivers:** `json-file`, `journald`, `syslog`, `fluentd`, `awslogs`

**Example:**
```yaml
logging:
  driver: json-file
```

options.markdownDescription:
Logging options passed to the driver via `--log-opt`.

**Example:**
```yaml
logging:
  driver: json-file
  options:
    max-size: 100m
    max-file: "3"
```

local.markdownDescription: The local path, relative to the app root.

mode.markdownDescription: File mode to set on the host, e.g. `"0600"`.

owner.markdownDescription: Owner to set on the host, e.g. `"mysql:mysql"`. Requires root access.

options.markdownDescription: Mount options, e.g. `ro` for read-only or `z`/`Z` for SELinux labels.

role.markdownDescription:
A role's configuration. Either a list of hosts, or a hash of options with the hosts under the `hosts` key.

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/roles/)

hosts.markdownDescription:
List of server IP addresses or hostnames. Servers can be tagged for custom environment variables.

**Example:**
```yaml
servers:
  workers:
    hosts:
      - 172.1.0.3
      - 172.1.0.4: experiment1
```

cmd.markdownDescription:
Custom command to run in the container for this role.

**Example:**
```yaml
servers:
  workers:
    cmd: bin/jobs
```

stop_timeout.markdownDescription:
How long to wait for a container in this role to stop after SIGTERM, in seconds. Overrides the root `stop_timeout`.

**Example:**
```yaml
servers:
  workers:
    stop_timeout: 30
```

options.markdownDescription:
Docker run options for containers in this role, passed as `--<name> <value>`.

**Example:**
```yaml
servers:
  workers:
    options:
      memory: 2g
      cpus: 2
```

cpus.markdownDescription: Number of CPUs to allocate to the container.

restart.markdownDescription:
Docker restart policy. Use `"no"` to disable restarts.

**Default:** `unless-stopped`

logging.markdownDescription: Docker logging configuration for this role, merged with the root `logging` configuration.

proxy.markdownDescription:
Whether to enable kamal-proxy for this role. The proxy is enabled by default on the primary role and disabled on other roles.

Set to `true` to inherit the root proxy configuration, or provide a hash of options to override it. Set to `false` on the primary role to disable the proxy.

**Example:**
```yaml
servers:
  web2:
    proxy: true
```

labels.markdownDescription:
Additional Docker labels for containers in this role. `destination`, `role` and `service` are reserved.

**Example:**
```yaml
servers:
  workers:
    labels:
      my-label: workers
```

env.markdownDescription: Role-specific environment variables. `tags` are only allowed in the root `env`.

asset_path.markdownDescription: Role-specific asset path for asset bridging. Overrides the root `asset_path`.

service.markdownDescription:
The service name used as the container name prefix. Required. Can only include alphanumeric characters, hyphens, and underscores.

**Example:**
```yaml
service: myapp
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#the-service-name)

image.markdownDescription:
The Docker image name that will be pushed to the configured registry.

**Example:**
```yaml
image: my-image
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#the-docker-image-name)

labels.markdownDescription:
Additional labels to add to the container. Labels are key-value pairs used for metadata.

**Example:**
```yaml
labels:
  my-label: my-value
  environment: production
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#labels)

volumes.markdownDescription:
Additional volumes to mount into the container

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#volumes)

servers.markdownDescription:
The servers to deploy to. Can be a simple list of IP addresses/hostnames (assigned to the `web` role) or a hash of role names to role configuration.

**Example:**
```yaml
servers:
  web:
    - 172.1.0.1
    - 172.1.0.2: experiment1
  workers:
    hosts:
      - 172.1.0.3
    cmd: bin/jobs
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/servers/)

asset_path.markdownDescription:
Path for asset bridging across deployments to avoid 404s during deploys. File names must change when contents change (e.g., content hash in filename). Kamal will map a volume containing both old and new asset files.

**Format:** `/path/to/assets` or `/path/to/assets:ro` (with mount options)

**Default:** `nil`

**Example:**
```yaml
asset_path: /rails/public/assets
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#asset-path)

hooks_path.markdownDescription:
Path to hooks directory for custom deploy scripts.

**Default:** `.kamal/hooks`

**Example:**
```yaml
hooks_path: /user_home/kamal/hooks
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#hooks-path)

hooks_output.markdownDescription:
Hook output visibility. Can be set globally or per hook. CLI flags (`-v`, `-q`) override these settings. With no setting, hook output follows CLI verbosity flags.

Failed hooks always show output in the error message regardless of this setting.

**Example:**
```yaml
hooks_output: :verbose
```

```yaml
hooks_output:
  pre-deploy: :verbose
  pre-build: :quiet
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#hook-output)

secrets_path.markdownDescription:
Path to secrets. Kamal looks for `<secrets_path>-common` first and then `<secrets_path>` (or `<secrets_path>.<destination>` when using destinations). Later files override earlier ones.

**Default:** `.kamal/secrets`

**Example:**
```yaml
secrets_path: /user_home/kamal/secrets
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#secrets-path)

error_pages_path.markdownDescription:
Directory relative to the app root containing error pages for the proxy to serve. Name each page after the HTTP status code it serves, e.g. `404.html`, `500.html`, `502.html`, `503.html` and `504.html`.

**Example:**
```yaml
error_pages_path: public
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#error-pages)

require_destination.markdownDescription:
Whether deployments require a destination to be specified with the `-d` flag.

**Default:** `false`

**Example:**
```yaml
require_destination: true
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#require-destinations)

primary_role.markdownDescription:
The primary role name. Defaults to `web`, but can be changed if you have no web role.

**Default:** `web`

**Example:**
```yaml
primary_role: workers
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#primary-role)

allow_empty_roles.markdownDescription:
Whether roles with no servers are allowed.

**Default:** `false`

**Example:**
```yaml
allow_empty_roles: true
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#allowing-empty-roles)

retain_containers.markdownDescription:
How many old containers and images to retain on the server.

**Default:** `5`

**Example:**
```yaml
retain_containers: 3
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#retain-containers)

minimum_version.markdownDescription:
The minimum version of Kamal required to deploy this configuration.

**Default:** `nil`

**Example:**
```yaml
minimum_version: 1.3.0
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#minimum-version)

readiness_delay.markdownDescription:
Seconds to wait for a container to boot after it is running. Only applies to containers without a proxy or healthcheck.

**Default:** `7`

**Example:**
```yaml
readiness_delay: 4
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#readiness-delay)

deploy_timeout.markdownDescription:
How long to wait for a container to become ready, in seconds.

**Default:** `30`

**Example:**
```yaml
deploy_timeout: 10
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#deploy-timeout)

drain_timeout.markdownDescription:
How long to wait for a container to drain connections, in seconds.

**Default:** `30`

**Example:**
```yaml
drain_timeout: 10
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#drain-timeout)

stop_timeout.markdownDescription:
How long to wait for a container to stop after SIGTERM, in seconds. Can be overridden per role.

**Default:** the `drain_timeout` for non-proxied roles and `10` (Docker default) for proxied roles.

**Example:**
```yaml
stop_timeout: 30
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#stop-timeout)

run_directory.markdownDescription:
Directory to store Kamal runtime files on the host.

**Default:** `.kamal`

**Example:**
```yaml
run_directory: /etc/kamal
```

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/overview/#run-directory)

ssh.markdownDescription:
SSH connection configuration for connecting to remote servers.

**Default:** Connects as `root` on port `22`

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/ssh/)

user.markdownDescription:
The SSH user to connect as.

**Default:** `root`

**Example:**
```yaml
ssh:
  user: app
```

port.markdownDescription:
The SSH port to connect to.

**Default:** `22`

**Example:**
```yaml
ssh:
  port: "2222"
```

proxy.markdownDescription:
Proxy (jump) host for SSH connections, in the form `host` or `user@host`. The user defaults to `root`.

**Example:**
```yaml
ssh:
  proxy: root@proxy-host
```

proxy_command.markdownDescription:
Custom proxy command for SSH connections. Required for older versions of SSH.

**Example:**
```yaml
ssh:
  proxy_command: "ssh -W %h:%p user@proxy"
```

log_level.markdownDescription:
SSH log level. Set to `debug` if you are having SSH connection issues.

**Default:** `fatal`
markdownEnumDescriptions: Show detailed SSH connection logs for troubleshooting

keys_only.markdownDescription:
Use only private keys from the `keys` and `key_data` parameters, ignoring ssh-agent identities. Useful when ssh-agent offers many identities or you need to force a single key.

**Default:** `false`

**Example:**
```yaml
ssh:
  keys_only: true
```

keys.markdownDescription:
Array of private key file paths for authentication.

**Example:**
```yaml
ssh:
  keys:
    - ~/.ssh/id.pem
```

key_data.markdownDescription:
⚠️ Array of secret names containing private keys in PEM format. Keys are loaded from the secrets file. Providing raw PEM key data inline is deprecated and will be removed in Kamal 3.

**Example:**
```yaml
ssh:
  key_data:
    - SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
```

config.markdownDescription:
Whether to load OpenSSH config files (`~/.ssh/config`, `/etc/ssh_config`). Set to `false` to ignore config files, or provide a path (or array of paths) to specific config files.

**Default:** `true`

**Example:**
```yaml
ssh:
  config: false
```

```yaml
ssh:
  config:
    - ~/.ssh/myconfig
```

forward_agent.markdownDescription:
Whether to forward the local SSH agent to the remote host. Set to `false` when connecting through a jump host or tunnel that does not support agent forwarding.

**Default:** `true`

**Example:**
```yaml
ssh:
  forward_agent: false
```

builder.markdownDescription:
Configuration for building Docker images with `docker build`. The `arch` option must be set.

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/builders/)

arch.markdownDescription:
The CPU architecture(s) to build for. Can be a single value or an array.

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  arch:
    - amd64
    - arm64
```
markdownEnumDescriptions: Build for ARM 64-bit processors (Apple Silicon, AWS Graviton, etc.)

remote.markdownDescription:
Connection string for a remote builder. Used for builds that don't match the local architecture.

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  remote: ssh://docker@docker-builder
```

local.markdownDescription:
Whether to use local builder for local architecture builds. Set to `false` to always use remote builder.

**Default:** `true`

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  local: false
```

cache.markdownDescription:
Build cache configuration to speed up builds. Type must be `gha` (GitHub Actions) or `registry`.

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  cache:
    type: registry
    image: kamal-app-build-cache
```

markdownEnumDescriptions: Use GitHub Actions cache (for CI/CD workflows)
Use container registry for cache storage

options.markdownDescription:
Additional cache options passed to Docker build.

**Example:** `mode=max`

image.markdownDescription:
Registry image name for cache storage. Only used with `registry` cache type.

**Default:** `<image>-build-cache`

**Example:** `kamal-app-build-cache`

context.markdownDescription:
Build context directory. If not set, a clean Git clone is used.

**Default:** Git clone (ensures clean build)

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  context: .
```

dockerfile.markdownDescription:
The Dockerfile to use for building.

**Default:** `Dockerfile`

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  dockerfile: Dockerfile.production
```

target.markdownDescription:
The build target/stage in a multi-stage Dockerfile.

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  target: production
```

args.markdownDescription:
Build arguments passed to `docker build` with `--build-arg`.

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  args:
    RUBY_VERSION: 3.3
    ENVIRONMENT: production
```

secrets.markdownDescription:
⚠️ Build secrets loaded from `.kamal/secrets` file. Use with `RUN --mount=type=secret` in Dockerfile.

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  secrets:
    - GITHUB_TOKEN
```

ssh.markdownDescription:
SSH agent socket or keys to expose to the build for private Git repositories.

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  ssh: default=$SSH_AUTH_SOCK
```

driver.markdownDescription:
The build driver to use. Can also use Docker Build Cloud with `cloud org-name/builder-name`.

**Default:** `docker-container`

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  driver: docker
```

provenance.markdownDescription:
Configure provenance attestations for the build result. Can also be a boolean to enable or disable provenance attestations.

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  provenance: mode=max
```

sbom.markdownDescription:
Enable Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) generation for the build.

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  sbom: true
```

pack.markdownDescription:
Build a Cloud Native Buildpack image using `pack`. Buildpacks only support building for one arch.

For additional customization, create a `project.toml` [project descriptor](https://buildpacks.io/docs/for-app-developers/how-to/build-inputs/use-project-toml/) file.

**Example:**
```yaml
builder:
  pack:
    builder: heroku/builder:24
    buildpacks:
      - heroku/ruby
      - heroku/procfile
```

builder.markdownDescription:
The buildpack builder image to use.

**Example:** `heroku/builder:24`

accessories.markdownDescription:
Additional services to run alongside your application (databases, Redis, etc.). Managed separately from the main service without zero-downtime deployments.

**Commands:** `kamal accessory boot <name>`, `kamal accessory --help`

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/accessories/)

service.markdownDescription:
Service name used in the service label.

**Default:** `<main-service>-<accessory>`

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    service: mysql
```

image.markdownDescription:
The Docker image to use for this accessory.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    image: mysql:8.0
```

registry.markdownDescription: Custom registry configuration for this accessory. Defaults to Docker Hub if not specified.

cmd.markdownDescription:
Custom command to run in the container.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    cmd: bin/mysqld
```

port.markdownDescription:
Port mapping in Docker format. ⚠️ Be careful about security when exposing ports publicly.

**Format:** `host:container` or `ip:host:container`

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    port: "127.0.0.1:3306:3306"
```

labels.markdownDescription:
Docker labels for this accessory container. `destination`, `role` and `service` are reserved.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    labels:
      app: myapp
```

options.markdownDescription:
Additional Docker run options passed as `--<name> <value>`.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    options:
      restart: always
      cpus: 2
```

restart.markdownDescription: Docker restart policy. Use `"no"` to disable restarts.

files.markdownDescription:
Files to mount into the container. Files are uploaded from local repo to host, then mounted. ERB files are evaluated before copying.

**Format:** `local:remote` or `local:remote:options` (options can be `ro` for read-only or `z`/`Z` for SELinux labels), or a hash with `local`, `remote`, `mode`, `owner` and `options` keys. Setting `owner` requires root access.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    files:
      - config/my.cnf:/etc/mysql/my.cnf
      - config/secret.key:/etc/mysql/secret.key:ro
      - local: config/ca-cert.pem
        remote: /etc/mysql/certs/ca-cert.pem
        mode: "0644"
        owner: "mysql:mysql"
```

directories.markdownDescription:
Directories to mount into the container. Created on the host before mounting.

**Format:** `local:remote` or `local:remote:options` (options can be `ro` for read-only or `z`/`Z` for SELinux labels), or a hash with `local`, `remote`, `mode`, `owner` and `options` keys. Setting `owner` requires root access.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    directories:
      - mysql-logs:/var/log/mysql
      - local: mysql-data
        remote: /var/lib/mysql
        mode: "0750"
        owner: "mysql:mysql"
```

volumes.markdownDescription:
Additional volumes to mount. Not created or copied before mounting.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    volumes:
      - /path/to/mysql-logs:/var/log/mysql
```

network.markdownDescription:
The Docker network to attach the accessory to.

**Default:** `kamal`

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    network: custom
```

proxy.markdownDescription: Run this accessory behind kamal-proxy for HTTP/HTTPS access.

host.markdownDescription:
Single host to run this accessory on.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    host: mysql-db1
```

hosts.markdownDescription:
Multiple hosts to run this accessory on.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    hosts:
      - mysql-db1
      - mysql-db2
```

role.markdownDescription:
Run on servers in this role.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    role: mysql
```

roles.markdownDescription:
Run on servers in these roles.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    roles:
      - mysql
      - database
```

tag.markdownDescription:
Run on servers with this tag.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    tag: writer
```

tags.markdownDescription:
Run on servers with these tags.

**Example:**
```yaml
accessories:
  mysql:
    tags:
      - writer
      - reader
```

boot.markdownDescription:
Control how containers are booted during deployment to avoid restarting all hosts simultaneously.

**Default:** Boot all hosts in parallel

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/booting/)

limit.markdownDescription:
Number or percentage of hosts to boot at a time.

**Format:** Integer (e.g., `3`) or percentage string (e.g., `25%`)

**Example:**
```yaml
boot:
  limit: 25%
```

wait.markdownDescription:
Seconds to wait between booting each group of hosts.

**Example:**
```yaml
boot:
  wait: 10
```

parallel_roles.markdownDescription:
Whether to boot roles in parallel on a host that has multiple roles.

**Default:** `false`

**Example:**
```yaml
boot:
  parallel_roles: true
```

sshkit.markdownDescription:
[SSHKit](https://github.com/capistrano/sshkit) options. The defaults should be sufficient for most use cases, but you may need to adjust them when connecting to a large number of hosts.

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/sshkit/)

max_concurrent_starts.markdownDescription:
Maximum number of SSH connections to start concurrently.

**Default:** `30`

**Example:**
```yaml
sshkit:
  max_concurrent_starts: 10
```

pool_idle_timeout.markdownDescription:
Idle timeout in seconds for pooled SSH connections.

**Default:** `900`

**Example:**
```yaml
sshkit:
  pool_idle_timeout: 300
```

dns_retries.markdownDescription:
Number of retries after the initial attempt when DNS lookups fail during concurrent SSH starts. Set to `0` to disable.

**Default:** `3`

**Example:**
```yaml
sshkit:
  dns_retries: 3
```

output.markdownDescription:
Configure where Kamal sends command output logs.

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/output/)

otel.markdownDescription:
Ship deploy logs to an OpenTelemetry-compatible endpoint via OTLP HTTP.

**Example:**
```yaml
output:
  otel:
    endpoint: http://otel-gateway:4318
```

file.markdownDescription:
Write deploy logs to a file on the local machine. One log file is created per deploy, named with the timestamp and command.

**Example:**
```yaml
output:
  file:
    path: /var/log/kamal/
```

path.markdownDescription: The directory to write log files to. Required.

aliases.markdownDescription:
Command aliases for shortcuts to common Kamal operations. Alias names can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, dashes, and underscores.

**Example:**
```yaml
aliases:
  console: app exec -i --reuse "bin/rails console"
  uname: app exec -p -q -r web "uname -a"
```

**Usage:** `kamal console`

[Kamal Docs](https://kamal-deploy.org/docs/configuration/aliases/)
